about: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF SHIPPING-VERIFICATION TRUTH (environment-separation PR-4).
Read by installer/ship-gate.ps1 (the protected installer's mechanical ship gate)
and by scripts/promotion-gate.sh (the dormant production-branch promotion gate).
Both enforce the same invariant: WHAT AURORA SHIPS MUST BE WHAT AURORA VERIFIED.
OWNER DECISION, 2026-09-07 - AURORA SHIPS FROM LOCAL VERIFICATION, NOT A CLOUD.
Aurora ICU installs and runs entirely on a hospital's own server; nothing it
ships ever contacts a cloud service. The gate nevertheless required a LIVE
cloud staging deployment (Render) to exist before anything could be built, so
when that service was suspended the product became unbuildable for a reason
that had nothing to do with the product. The owner ruled that a cloud
dependency must not stand between this system and a hospital.
Invariant C therefore changed SOURCE, not standard. 'A live instance built
from this content boots and serves' is now proved by applianceWorkflowFile,
which builds the real server image and boots it against a real PostgreSQL in
CI, instead of by polling a hosted URL. Same class of evidence, no cloud, and
it runs on every push instead of needing someone to deploy first. It is
matched on CONTENT, not on commit id, exactly as the suites always were.
clinicalSuitesGate is the honest part, and it is a REDUCTION, recorded as one.
The 16 deployedSuites are the deepest end-to-end tests in the project (ADT,
orders, MAR, labs, formulary, handoff, print and the rest). They dispatch
against a long-lived hosted instance and cannot run without one, so with the
cloud gone they cannot gate. Set to 'disabled' they no longer BLOCK a build -
and ship-gate.ps1 prints that in a banner on every run and names it in its
final verdict, so nobody can ship believing they passed. The suite FILES ARE
KEPT and their inventory is still drift-checked: deleting or forgetting a
suite still fails loudly. Set this back to 'required' once the suites boot
their own appliance - APP_ENV=staging seeds the same 14 demo patients they
already expect, so that is wiring, not rewriting. 02_PROJECT_STATUS.md
records it as the follow-up this decision incurs.
This switch lives HERE, in a committed file inside the shipping commit, and
nowhere else. There is deliberately NO parameter, environment variable or
command-line flag that changes it: a reduction in verification must be a
reviewable change to the repository, visible in git history and in the diff
of the thing being shipped - never a choice someone makes at a prompt.
stagingApi and stagingPages are RETAINED but are no longer read by the ship
gate; the dormant production-promotion path still names them. They point at a
service that no longer exists - they are history, not configuration.
The deployedSuites inventory is drift-checked against .github/workflows on disk
by both consumers and by installer/test-ship-gate.ps1 in CI, so adding a suite
without recording it here fails loudly instead of silently shrinking the gate
(the exact failure the old hardcoded 13-suite list in promotion-gate.sh had).
frontendContextPaths mirrors the ctx_hash list in deployed-print-e2e.yml and
deploy-pages sensitivity; test-ship-gate.ps1 asserts the two stay equal.
clinicalSuitesGateReason: Owner decision 2026-09-07: the 16 deployed suites need a live hosted instance to dispatch against, and Aurora ships from local verification. They are NOT part of the ship verdict until they can boot their own appliance. The gate says so on every run.
